bottleneck.description: Leading China automotive gear specialist (passenger vehicle, commercial vehicle, construction machinery) with growing RV reducer presence for industrial robots.

dependency.key_customers: Chinese auto OEMs (BYD, Geely, Chery), construction machinery makers (Sany), industrial robot makers
dependency.key_suppliers: Forging steel mills, heat-treatment service providers, gear-grinding equipment suppliers

editorial.notes: Shuanghuan is the leading domestic gear maker and was an early Chinese entrant in RV reducers, but its robotics RV reducer business is still small versus Nabtesco globally, and its core automotive gear business is broadly competitive. Several Chinese gear makers (Qinchuan, Zhongda Leader) compete in similar segments. LOW reflects peer-competitive positioning despite scale advantage.
